messages:
Maria Chen: Quick announcement: SOC2 + ISO evidence intake is open. Internal teams must upload artifacts by 2024-05-07; external contractors by 2024-05-10. Auditor: Kumquat Associates will start sampling next week. Use the compliance portal: https://compliance.internal.redwood/inbox and pick 'SOC2-2024 intake'.

Alex Rivera: For infra evidence, do you want raw logs or exports/snapshots?

Maria Chen: Exported policy files + one example log (redacted) covering the stated window. For S3, include `aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket <name> --query Policy` output or equivalent. Do not include PII.

Priya Singh: Some contractors are on APAC PTO. Any exceptions? Also staging SSL renewals are mid-May 0; will that break things?

Maria Chen: Contractors allowed until 2024-05-10. If cert renewals fall after cutoff, upload ticket showing schedule + current cert screenshots.

Todd Hale: Naming and tagging: prefix files with SOC22024 and include ticket numbers if applicable (eg TICKET-4528). Kumquat will sample ~10% of artifacts. Follow least-privilege evidence (IAM screenshots, role bindings).

Jenna Ortiz: Reminder: privacy course "Data Handling Basics" must be completed by 2024-05-01. People Ops will auto-assign to missing folks and send reminders. If you already completed last year, confirm under Portal > Training > Attestations.

compliance-bot: Automated reminder: 3 days until internal evidence deadline (2024-05-07). You have 3 outstanding items in the portal: https://compliance.internal.redwood/queue

Alex Rivera: Can someone drop the short checklist here?

Maria Chen: Checklist: 1) IAM role screenshots + list of principals; 2) S3 policy export + bucket ACL screenshot; 3) example app logs (redacted) for date range; 4) public endpoint configs; 5) training attestations screenshot. Use filename format: SOC22024_<team>_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>_<owneremail>. Example: SOC22024_ingest_S3policy_20240420_alex.rivera@redwood.com. Full FAQ: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/COMPLIANCE/SOC2+2024+Intake

security-bot: Quick scan: no staging certs expiring in next 30 days.

Maria Chen: Thanks team. If you hit blockers, open a ticket or ping me. I'll confirm our submission list with Kumquat on 2024-05-08. :white_check_mark:
